morgan: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem  recurring KV eviction spikes during peak. We need a short, exact triage checklist, the playbook escalation matrix, owners for each item, and due dates. Who can take which bits?
incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction-patterns  logs + traces attached.
priya: Ill own the escalation matrix + pager rules (incl. Dedicated tenants). Will draft the table with paging thresholds and contact lists.
soren: I can draft the triage steps and exact commands for the on-call playbook. Keeping it minimal for 0-15m operators. Draft below  feedback welcome:
```
# KV eviction quick triage (0-15m)
1) Pods & restarts: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) Quick logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 120 | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|oom"
3) Snapshot metrics: curl -fsS 'http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?svc=runtime' | jq '.kv_cache.evictions, .mem.rss, .gpu.util'
4) If evictions > 50/min -> reduce batch_size & restart gateway:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) If still noisy: request KV dump (auth required): curl -u svc-sre:REDACTED -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz
6) Post-restart smoke: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && echo '{"prompt":"warmup"}' | http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate
7) If unresolved after 15m -> page @oncall; after 30m -> page @runtime-leads; if Dedicated tenants affected -> page @dedicated-esc immediately and cc @support
```
tay: I'll be runbook owner and will open the docs PR. Target: PR opened by 2026-04-10, merge by 2026-04-13. I'll link the PR here when ready.
evan: I'll produce a tiny smoke script for step 6 and a lightweight weekly job to detect recurring spikes (alerts runtime-leads). Will link gist in PR.
morgan: Good. Let's create follow-up INCs so we can track closure. I'll create them now and post IDs.
morgan: Follow-ups created: INC-8305 (runbook PR) -> tay, due 2026-04-13; INC-8306 (triage commands + KV dump auth note) -> soren, due 2026-04-07; INC-8307 (escalation matrix + pager updates) -> priya, due 2026-04-05; INC-8308 (smoke script + weekly detector) -> evan, due 2026-04-08.
priya: Ack. For the pager table: page @oncall at 10m, page @runtime-leads at 25m, page @eng-sre for repeated events (3+ in 24h). Dedicated tenants get immediate dedicated-esc paging and cc support. I'll include contact matrix in playbook.
soren: ACK INC-8306. I'll include a safe dump example and note the required auth scope in the runbook.
evan: Gist for smoke script will include exit codes and a verbose flag for debug.
morgan: Perfect. Please drop PR & gist links back in this thread when ready. I'll mark the postmortem follow-ups resolved once all INCs are closed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
